name: Botan
source: Botan is Kyou's pet baby boar, and is a comic relief character. Botan will sometimes go to Kyou's school just to see her. Due to his small size and the fact that he is a baby boar, he is sometimes captured by several characters who talk of eating him. [spoiler]In the After Story, Botan has become an adult boar, but still acts the same.[/spoiler] Botan has seven different skills.
